name: Synapse - SLA Breach Alerting
description: Monitors open unresolved incident tickets against defined SLA thresholds (e.g. P1 < 15m, P2 < 60m). Escalates directly to incident commander if SLA is at risk.

settings.text: :warning: *SLA BREACH ALERT*: {{step_2.breaches.length}} incident(s) exceed resolution targets!\n{{step_2.breaches.map(b => `• ${b.service_name} (${b.severity}) - Open for ${b.ageMinutes}m (Target: ${b.slaLimit}m)`).join('\n')}}
